docs.question: Which 3 stations have the highest peak-hour shortage rate?
docs.answer: The highest peak-hour shortage rates were at Phibsborough Road (100%), Golden Lane (70.65%), and Portobello Road (59.88%). These rates are based on 70.38, 64.3, and 74.78 observed peak-hour minutes, respectively.

docs.question: Compare the average number of available bikes in hours with precipitation versus dry hours.
docs.answer: Across station-hours, an average of 11.65 bikes were available during hours with precipitation, compared with 11.84 during dry hours—a difference of 0.19 bikes. The comparison covers 457 station-hours with precipitation and 876 dry station-hours.
docs.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE had_precipitation IS TRUE AND avg_available_bikes IS NOT NULL) AS wet_station_hours, ROUND(CAST(AVG(avg_available_bikes) FILTER(WHERE had_precipitation IS TRUE) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS wet_avg_bikes, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE had_precipitation IS FALSE AND avg_available_bikes IS NOT NULL) AS dry_station_hours, ROUND(CAST(AVG(avg_available_bikes) FILTER(WHERE had_precipitation IS FALSE) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS dry_avg_bikes, ROUND(CAST(AVG(avg_available_bikes) FILTER(WHERE had_precipitation IS TRUE) - AVG(avg_available_bikes) FILTER(WHERE had_precipitation IS FALSE) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS difference FROM marts.agg_station_hourly LIMIT 200
